name: Palomino Labs Inc
summary: Palomino Laboratories, Inc. is a semiconductor and optical communications company. It engages in the provision of developing high-speed, energy-efficient data transfer technologies for AI data centres, cloud computing, and computing systems. It specializes in gallium nitride (GaN) MicroLED-based optical interconnect solutions designed to replace traditional copper wiring and improve bandwidth, latency, and power efficiency in next-generation computing infrastructure. The company was founded by Jeffrey B. Shealy and Steven Den Baarson March 10, 2022 and is headquartered in Goleta, CA.
